tieu_de: Senior Security Operations Center SOC Specialist
mo_ta_cong_viec:
Cybersecurity and Information Security Monitoring & Alerting
Respond to and investigate information security incidents.
Proactively defend against and prevent cyberattacks.
Manage information security procedures, drills, exercises, and reporting.
Ensure service quality and compliance with established processes and regulations.
Prepare reports, maintain records, and perform other duties as assigned.
yeu_cau:
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Electronics & Telecommunications, Auditing, or other relevant disciplines.
Relevant experience in IT within the financial and banking sector or in related business functions.
Knowledge and skills in communication, analysis, problem-solving, and logical thinking.
Professional manner, integrity, strong compliance mindset, and ability to work under pressure.
Preferred certifications: CCNA, MCSA, LPT, CCNP, MCSE, CEH, CHFI, etc.
